texts.1dd086528a1c:
HPS 3 / TIMI 55: REVEAL (Randomized EValuation of the Effects of Anacetrapib through Lipid-modification)

The study aims to randomise at least 30,000 participants (6,500 in the UK) aged 50 years or older with pre-existing vascular disease, to receive either anacetrapib 100mg daily or matching placebo for a median of  4 years’ follow-up. The primary aim is to assess the effect of lipid-modification with anacetrapib on major coronary events (MCE – defined as coronary death, myocardial infarction or coronary revascularization).

Data access is restricted to those named in section 7 of this agreement. Any changes will be notified to the NHS IC.
